title: JSON Nodes
outcome_summary: Successfully implemented a complete suite of 7 ComfyUI V3 custom nodes for JSON manipulation (4 primitive value nodes, 2 structural nodes, 1 file-output node with security audit), packaged as a drop-in extension with no external dependencies. All 7 work packages completed across 23 pipeline stages (implementation, QA, security-audit, code-review, documentation) with 164/164 tests passing and 0 security findings. The project produces a fully documented, production-ready extension that enables structured JSON object construction and file output directly within ComfyUI workflows via dot-notation key support.
